request.guests: integer; defaults to every hall base price

reasonSemantics.no_prices: No event price for the request; days still expose free-unit data.
reasonSemantics.no_availability: Availability is not managed online; freeUnits is null.

calendarContract.meaning: Per date and hall, morning/evening free units and base-guest price; roomID optionally narrows the response.

vacancyContract.authority: Final exact booking availability and price; use immediately before booking.

legacyReadOnlyProbe.observedPriceBehavior: Most cards had no displayed price; HTML data-lowprice was 999999 and is not authoritative.
legacyReadOnlyProbe.dateSensitivity: The cohorts differ by date: 2026-11-05 contains 1167 but not 2242; 2026-11-12 contains 2242 but not 1167. Ordering also changes.

implementationImplication.rootCause: The local event adapter reads site.available/minPrice/cheapest but drops days[].slot.freeUnits.
implementationImplication.availableUnpricedRule: For exact date, slot and guest-compatible room, freeUnits > 0 with missing price becomes available_unpriced and routes to phone/WhatsApp, not fast booking.
implementationImplication.unknownRule: freeUnits null or absent remains unknown; never infer availability from no_prices alone.
implementationImplication.finalCheck: Use events/{siteID}/vacancy before any online booking.
